title: Igama Elinikezwe Ngaphambi Kokuzalwa
intro: Cabanga ngendawo engcwele ethule egcwele ukunxusa okuqotho ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokulinda. Kokungabonakali kuvela impendulo ephethe igama elingakaze linikezwe ngaphambili, ukuhlakanipha okuthembisayo kwasebuntwaneni kanye nokuphila okuphawulwe ukuzinikela, ububele, kanye nobumsulwa.
clues: Ngaqanjwa ngu-Allah uqobo lwami ngaphambi kokuba ngizalwe, igama elingakaze linikezwe muntu ngaphambi kwami.
Ngavunyelwa njengempendulo yokunxusa okuqotho kwabazali asebekhulile ababecabanga ukuthi inzalo ayinakwenzeka.
Nganikwa ukuhlakanipha, ukwahlulela, kanye nemiBhalo ngesikhathi ngiseyingane.
Nganginesibopho kubazali bami futhi nginozwela kwabanye, futhi ngangingazikhukhumezi noma ngingalaleli.
U-Allah wamisa ukuthula phezu kwami ​​​​ngosuku engazalwa ngalo, ngosuku engifa ngalo, nangosuku engizovuswa ngalo ngiphila.
Ubaba uZakariya wathola izindaba ezinhle ngami ezingelosini ngesikhathi emi ethandaza endaweni engcwele (mihrab).

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
